description: This file contains functions for parsing and transforming locators and selectors used in Playwright testing framework, including handling of locator strings, converting them into selector engines, and digesting locators for comparison.

methods.name: parseLocator
methods.description: Parses a locator string into a selector and preferred quote, transforming locator syntax into a normalized form.

methods.name: countParams
methods.description: Counts the number of parameters in a template string.

methods.name: shiftParams
methods.description: Adjusts parameter indices in a template string by a given offset.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a locator template into a selector string, handling nested filters and converting to selector engine syntax.

methods.name: digestForComparison
methods.description: Creates a digest of a locator string for comparison, normalizing whitespace and escaping characters based on language.
